shortDescription: Perform the Day1 first run initialization of a VxRail Cluster

options.name: api_version_number
options.description: A specific version number to use for the API call. If not included, will use the highest version by default

options.name: day1json_file
options.description: The path of Day1 Json file.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time out value for Day1 bring up, the default value is 18000 seconds

options.name: vxmip
options.description: The IP address of the VxRail Manager System
